title: Brand new customer, no interaction history -- trend is honestly 'insufficient data', recommendation still works

utterances.text: Thanks for calling, this is Priya -- how can I help today?
Hi, I just opened an account with you last week, still getting used to everything.
Welcome aboard! Happy to help you get settled -- what can I do for you?
I was wondering if there's a good way to start putting a bit of money aside each month.
That's a great habit to start early -- let me check what's available on your account.
Thanks, I don't really know what's normal for a new customer like me.
No worries at all, I'll walk you through it clearly.
That would be great, appreciate it.
Here's what I'd suggest to get started.
That sounds like a good starting point, thank you.
You're welcome -- thanks for calling, and welcome again!
